description: This is a shell script for testing git's signed commits functionality, specifically testing various signature types (OpenPGP, X.509, SSH) and behaviors related to signing, importing, stripping, and validating commit signatures within a git repository.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the specified git repository, used to set up test scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Checks or sets configuration options for the git repository or environment.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies output is empty, used to confirm certain operations produce no output.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches output or files for specific patterns.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a given output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Confirms that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the timestamp used for creating commit dates.
